Headquarters: Toronto
 
URL: https://www.poweredbysearch.com/

Ready to shape the future of B2B SaaS SEO while working with some of the fastest-growing companies in tech?

If you're equally passionate about driving strategic SEO initiatives and building strong senior client relationships, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for an SEO Strategist who can lead client conversations, turn SEO complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our Mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B SaaS companies unstoppable.

We're on a mission to be the best in the world at SaaS marketing — doing work we love, with people we like, how we want.

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

This is a client-facing strategic SEO role. You won’t just be auditing websites or creating recommendations in isolation. You’ll be expected to lead conversations, explain tradeoffs, guide clients toward decisions, and connect SEO work to business outcomes.

You'll have the freedom to:

• Drive holistic SEO strategies that deliver measurable business impact

• Build strong, strategic relationships with SaaS marketing leaders

• Shape the future of SEO in an AI-first search landscape

• Work with a team that values strategic thinking as much as technical expertise

• Own client outcomes through clear strategy, communication, and follow-through

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

• Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment

• Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations

• Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities

• Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly

• Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights

• Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps

• Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions

• Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search

• Embrace our core values:

• 

• Give a Sh!t

• Always Be in It To Win It

• Be Obsessed with Serving Others

• Practice a Growth Mindset

• When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

• Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals

• Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations

• Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions

• Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations

• Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps

• Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

• Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients

• Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders

• Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence

• Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask

• Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines

• Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

• Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization

• Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance

• Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels

• Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights

• Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies

• Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

• 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS

• Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution

• Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients

• Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention

• Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement

• Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates

• Strong judgment in prioritizing SEO work based on business impact, client context, and implementation realities

• Ability to present performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps clearly to senior stakeholders

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

• You prefer doing SEO execution without leading client conversations

• You struggle to explain SEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

• You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations

• You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, or guiding senior clients toward decisions

• Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for live client-facing strategy conversations

• You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and client follow-through

Why Join Us?

• Work with a team that values strategic thinking and innovation

• Competitive base salary plus quarterly performance bonuses

• 5 weeks of paid time off

• Fully remote work environment with flexible hours — you just need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with North American time zones

• Comprehensive health spending account and eye/dental/medical benefits for Canadian residents

• Regular team meetups and annual retreats

• Clear career progression path without requiring a management track

• Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies

• Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers

• Access to proven playbooks, frameworks, and professional development opportunities

What Future Co-Workers Say

Here are some comments from your future co-workers about their experience at Powered by Search:

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

• Working with top 1% SaaS experts

• Supportive and empathetic leadership

• End-to-end control with no account manager involvement

• Highly data-driven and results-oriented

• Remote-first with a supportive global team and flexible work hours

• Your growth here in 1 year is similar to 3 to 4 years in other companies

Your Growth Journey

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

You'll receive:

• Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers

• Access to our proven playbooks and frameworks

• Regular professional development opportunities

• Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies

• Clear feedback on how to grow as a strategist, communicator, and client leader

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/powered-by-search-senior-seo-organic-growth-strategist

5bd94c45e6752dab.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D&A) – DBT, BigQuery, Airflow - Data Engineer - Senior

As part of our EY-GDS D&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the power of data and technology. We work across industries including Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Supply Chain, and Finance to deliver scalable and innovative data solutions.

The Opportunity

We're looking for candidates with strong experience in modern data engineering practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in building and managing end-to-end data pipelines, data transformation using dbt, and working with Google BigQuery and Apache Airflow. Experience in data warehousing, Star/Snowflake schema design, and Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) data domains is preferred.

Your Technical Responsibilities

• Design, build, orchestrate, and manage end-to-end data pipelines.
• Develop scalable and maintainable data transformation workflows using dbt.
• Participate in the full software and data development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
• Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across data platforms.
• Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following engineering best practices.
• Work with structured and semi-structured data sources to support analytics and reporting needs.
• Troubleshoot and optimize existing data pipelines and workflows.
• Develop, test, and maintain high-quality software and data engineering solutions using Python.

Requirements (Qualifications)

• BE/BTech/MCA with 3 to 5 years of relevant industry experience.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

• 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering.
• Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling.
• Experience in building and managing end-to-end data pipelines.
• Strong proficiency in SQL and Google BigQuery.
• Experience with Apache Airflow for workflow orchestration.
• Strong understanding of Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT, and Star/Snowflake schema design.
• Proficiency in Python for data engineering and automation.
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
• Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to a fast-paced development environment.

Primary Skills

• Data Build Tool (DBT)
• Google BigQuery
• Apache Airflow
• Proven experience in building, orchestrating and managing end-to-end data pipelines

Good to have

• Python

Ideally, You'll Also Have

• Client management and stakeholder communication skills.
• Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
• Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and modern data architecture concepts.

What We Look For

• Professionals with strong technical capabilities and a passion for data engineering.
• Individuals who are eager to learn and adapt to emerging technologies and industry trends.
• Team players who can deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment.

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, solve their toughest challenges. You'll work on meaningful projects while developing your technical and professional skills.

• Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced professionals.
• Opportunities to learn new technologies and advance your career.
• Flexibility and freedom to manage your work effectively.
• Exposure to diverse projects, industries, and global teams.

About EY

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction, and consulting services, EY is committed to building a better working world. We invest in our people through learning, development, and career growth opportunities that help them achieve their full potential.

Join us in building a better working world. Apply now.

EY | Building a better working world 

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Associate Director – Strategy
Location: Powai, Mumbai
Work Mode: Work from Office (5 Days a Week – Monday to Friday)

About Truemeds
Our vision is to make healthcare affordable and accessible to all.
Truemeds is a technology-driven telehealth platform that aims to reduce healthcare expenses and improve healthcare outcomes by democratizing medicine purchases in India. Through precise scientific matching and outcomes-based recommendations, Truemeds helps customers access best-value medicines from India's top pharmaceutical brands, enabling savings of up to 70% on medicine costs.
We believe that no one should have to choose between their health and their healthcare expenses. Our mission is to become the preferred e-pharmacy for smart consumers seeking high-quality, cost-effective medicines.

About the Role
Truemeds is looking to hire highly driven individuals who can own end-to-end strategic initiatives and their implementation. This team holds a critical position within the company and works on some of the organization's largest and highest-impact projects, spanning both strategy and execution.

What Can You Expect to Work On?
• Strategy, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Optimization, Growth Projects & Finance – You'll wear multiple hats and work across diverse business functions, managing high-impact initiatives from ideation to execution.
• Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to scale the business with one common objective in mind—improving customer delight and experience. This includes initiating and executing end-to-end strategic partnerships for growth and value optimization.
• Understand and prioritize the company's key business challenges, and design strategic initiatives to improve critical business KPIs such as unit economics, customer retention, repeat business, and profitability.
• Brainstorm, evaluate, and build new lines of business as Truemeds expands beyond its core offerings.
• Get a unique opportunity to be in the front seat as we build the next big consumer internet company.

We Would Love to Chat If You Have / Are
• 3–5 years of post-MBA experience across Consulting, Investment Banking, Private Equity (PE), Venture Capital (VC), or high-growth startups.
• A strategic thinker who can critically evaluate ideas, collaborate effectively, make informed decisions, and drive execution to closure.
• Entrepreneurial in spirit, with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to get things done.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand data and derive meaningful business insights.
• A mindset of making every day count and continuously striving to create impact.

Why Should You Apply?
• Excellent Learning Opportunity – Get a front-row seat as we build and scale the business.
• Work closely with the senior-most stakeholders in the organization on some of the company's most impactful strategic initiatives.
• Witness your ideas come to life by driving strategy through execution and seeing measurable business outcomes.
• Take on leadership opportunities and grow with the organization as we scale.
• Become part of a rocketship with a proven product-market fit and a singular goal of expanding across the country.

Who Should Apply?
We're looking for high-caliber professionals who thrive in fast-paced, problem-solving environments and have a strong track record of driving business impact.
Preferred Profile
• MBA from a Tier-1 B-School (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR, MDI, JBIMS, TISS, or equivalent premier institutes).
• Graduated in 2021 or 2022.
• Prior experience with top-tier consulting firms such as McKinsey & Company, Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group (BCG), Kearney, Oliver Wyman, Strategy&, EY-Parthenon, or similar strategy consulting firms.
• Experience working in a high-growth startup after consulting, with exposure to Strategy, Business Operations, Growth, Analytics, or Founder's Office roles will be strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to solve complex business problems using structured thinking, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration.
• Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive initiatives from ideation to execution.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and project management skills.

Business Analyst

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with clients, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to gather, analyze, document, and validate business requirements. You will play a key role in ensuring that business objectives are translated into clear functional requirements, enabling the successful delivery of high-quality software solutions.

The Business Analyst should possess excellent communication, analytical, and documentation skills, with the ability to understand business challenges and recommend practical, technology-driven solutions.

Requirements

• Evaluate business processes, identify requirements, uncover areas for improvement, and develop effective solutions.
• Manage and track requirements throughout the project lifecycle to ensure successful delivery.
• Stay updated with the latest business processes and IT advancements to support automation and system modernization.
• Interpret customer requirements into feasible business and technical solutions, and communicate them effectively to stakeholders.
• Prepare clear, accurate, and concise Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) using standard templates.
• Conduct peer reviews of business requirements to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with project objectives.
• Translate business and customer requirements into functional specifications that are easy for the development team to understand and implement.
• Monitor project deliverables and ensure timely completion in coordination with cross-functional teams
• Expertise in AI Tools and Process Automations 
• Previous experience in handling ERP Projects 
• Expertise in client ready prototyping using traditional/AI Tools 

What we Expect from you?

• 1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst in software development projects.
• Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent mathematical and critical thinking abilities.
• Strong documentation and requirement-gathering skills.
• Highly self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
• Ability to prioritize tasks and perform effectively under pressure.
• Experience in preparing reports and delivering presentations.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
• Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, team-oriented environment.
• Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and listening skills.

What you've got?

• Opportunity to work on diverse and challenging software development projects.
• Exposure to modern business analysis practices, tools, and methodologies.
• A collaborative and supportive work environment with experienced professionals.
• Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
